description: Order book depth of one coin's perpetual on Bybit, Hyperliquid, dYdX, Gate, Kraken, Bitfinex, Deribit and OKX: best bid/ask, spread in bps, market depth in USD within 0.1/0.5/1/2% of mid, bid/ask imbalance, estimated slippage for your order size and the largest resting orders (walls). L2 orderbook liquidity for BTC, ETH, SOL and more. Data only. Bad input is free; under 2 venues not charged. Price: $0.003 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base); pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"].

levels.description: Also return the top N levels per side (0-20). Default 0.

size_usd.description: Order size in USD for the slippage estimate. Default 100000.
